**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

- **Clause:** § 14.3 Choice of Law (p0171) — "governed by the substantive laws of the State of New York, without regard for its conflict of laws provisions."
- **Law:** New York — exactly the playbook's preferred jurisdiction.
- **Forum:** No arbitration clause exists anywhere in the Agreement, so disputes proceed in court; no foreign seat or IBM home-jurisdiction venue, so nothing approaching walk-away territory.
- **Noted, not flagged:** the Agreement has no express exclusive-venue designation (§ 14.4 jury waiver and § 14.14 two-year actions period touch on litigation but not forum). This is a minor sub-element short of the preferred wording — it leaves default forum rules and is not adverse to us — so it is recorded in the rationale only. If the miscellaneous article is opened for other reasons, we can add exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County to reach the full preferred position.
